Author: Juvvadi Sridevi

entities.text: Imran Ilyas Merchant vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.2779 of 2025
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.9172 of 2022 on the file of XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 27.02.2025, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 04.03.2025 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 are allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 in C.C.No.9172 of 2022 on the file of XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
